about: Paraphrases of 10 answerable questions: each must cite the same document and fact as the question it rewords (ASK-01, FIX-01).

questions.query: Which port is the billing gateway reachable on?
At what canary error rate does a deploy roll back by itself?
Within how many minutes does the primary on-call have to acknowledge?
How much can I spend on food per day when I travel?
For how many days do we keep audit logs?
After declaring a SEV1, when is the first status page update due?
When does the nightly rebuild of the product search index run?
How long does a feature flag live before it expires?
What crash-free rate must the mobile rollout keep to advance?
What is the rotation period for secrets in the vault?
